parts.name: Hour Hand
parts.Basic_description: This is the hour hand of the clock, made of aluminum, slender and short compared to the minute hand.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the hour on the clock face by rotating slowly around the center axis.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central axis of the clock in a continuous, slow motion driven by the clock mechanism.

parts.name: Minute Hand
parts.Basic_description: This is the minute hand of the clock, made of aluminum, longer and thinner than the hour hand.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the minutes on the clock face by rotating around the center axis at a faster rate than the hour hand.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central axis of the clock once every hour, driven by the internal clock mechanism.

parts.name: Clock Surface
parts.Basic_description: This is the main surface or face of the clock, made of plastic, circular in shape with decorative hour markers.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the base structure that holds the clock hands and provides a readable background for time indication.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and supports the rotating hands and internal clock mechanism.
